target: apps/observer/frontend/src (App.tsx shell, components/layout/{Sidebar,TopStatusBar}.tsx, components/ui/{drawer,command-palette,toast,states}.tsx, views/* 22 lanes, skins/b10.css + skins/l10b-shell.css + index.css)
mode: A (automatic code review); no spark chain context found, project authority UI_DECISIONS.md D-01..D-16 used as the consistency baseline

findings.description: At <=840px the shell hides .top-actions, so theme switch, full/compact switch, workspace drawer and notifications become unreachable; the mobile nav panel exposes only lane list + close, and the only alternate path (Ctrl/Cmd+K) requires a physical keyboard.
findings.suggestion: Reuse onCycleTheme/onCycleLayout/onOpenDrawer in the mobile-nav-panel footer, or keep an icon-only .top-actions at <=840px; add a breakpoint contract test asserting the four actions stay reachable on narrow viewports.

findings.description: An unknown ?view= id calls setView() inside the render body and returns null, producing a 'cannot update a component while rendering' warning, one blank content frame, and no user-visible explanation that the deep link was invalid.
findings.suggestion: Normalise the view id in readInitialView()/useEffect (render stays read-only) and render UnknownState stating 'unknown lane, returned to Overview'.

findings.description: Two CSS authorities compete: the verbatim unlayered B10 skin (533 lines) beats Tailwind @layer, so the shell layer must re-assert breakpoints and use !important (.sidebar-slot display:none!important, .sr-only 8 !important rules). The 840/841px threshold is duplicated across two files, so a change on either side silently desynchronises.
findings.suggestion: Collapse visibility/breakpoint rules into one shell source (single breakpoint constant, one display rule), move sr-only back to layered utilities, and long-term tokenize the skin into @layer skins to retire !important (same root cause D-16 recorded for light theme).

findings.description: No loading state exists anywhere: grep for 'loading|加载' returns 0 hits across the six main view files. On the first frame before the snapshot arrives (snap==null && !error) the whole page renders UNKNOWN, so 'fetching' is indistinguishable from 'genuinely no data'. states.tsx ships state components with no caller.
findings.suggestion: Render a one-shot skeleton (or LoadingState) for the first frame and separate LOADING / STALE / OFFLINE / UNKNOWN in both the UI and the a11y announcements (App.tsx:178-186 currently announces only the last three).

findings.description: Drawer and CommandPalette declare role=dialog + aria-modal=true but implement no focus containment and no focus restore; only modal.tsx saves previouslyFocused. Keyboard users can Tab into background content that aria-modal claims to hide.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared useFocusTrap(active, ref) (Tab cycle + Esc + restore focus) reused by drawer, command-palette and modal; add an RTL test asserting the Nth Tab wraps to the first focusable element.

findings.description: All toast variants share role=status and auto-dismiss after 1800ms, including error toasts, and hover does not pause the timer, so errors vanish before they can be read or acted on (WCAG 2.2.1 timing).
findings.suggestion: Use role=alert and no auto-dismiss (or >=10s with hover/focus pause) for variant==='error'; keep 1800ms for info/success.

findings.description: UI_DECISIONS D-02 locks a 72px collapsed rail width, but no collapse implementation exists (grep collaps|72px|fold = 0 hits in Sidebar and both skins; the only match is the unrelated table min-width:720px). Narrow screens instead hide the rail entirely and offer a drawer.
findings.suggestion: Either implement the collapsed rail (72px icon state) or mark that D-02 sentence as not-implemented/abandoned, so a later session does not re-open completed work - the same failure class as the stale HANDOFF-UI-L10B line that misled three sessions.

findings.description: Three lanes have two rendering paths: monitoring/trust/settings are registered in VIEW_REGISTRY with components AND hardcoded in App.tsx branches that win first. The registry is the U04 single source of truth, so 'add a lane by editing only the registry' stops being true.
findings.suggestion: Delete the three App branches and resolve every lane through VIEW_REGISTRY.find(...); add a test asserting a lane component can only come from the registry.

findings.description: Lane-count authority has drifted: Sidebar.tsx:54 and the registry describe 22 lanes in 7 groups, while OPEN-TASK-REGISTER P1-01 and the 2026-10-06 audit conclusion still say '16 reachable lanes / 15 lane -> 7 nav'. A session reading the stale figure will misjudge a healthy tree as a regression (it biased this review's own input).
findings.suggestion: Derive the lane count from the viewRegistry test instead of hand-writing numbers, and append a dated correction to the register row rather than rewriting the historical text.
findings.location: apps/observer/frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx:54; taskpacks/current/OPEN-TASK-REGISTER.md P1-01; D:/All projects/Record/01_审计结论.md

findings.description: The palette's Overview entry hardcodes label '总览' next to the OVERVIEW_ID registry label, giving the same entry two label sources.
findings.suggestion: Take the label from the registry/OVERVIEW metadata.

findings.description: '320px-safe' for the compact HUD is only a code comment: CompactHUD does not use .kpi-grid (the rule that collapses to one column at <=840px) and no 320-375px viewport test exists.
findings.suggestion: Add a 320px viewport contract test so the claim becomes verifiable.

findings.description: State vocabulary mixes languages inside one panel: '数据源未接入（UNKNOWN）' beside 'Read-only', 'Local State', 'Rendering', 'Motion Effects'.
findings.suggestion: Fix a glossary (投影/数据源/只读) and route tags through it.
